caption:
Egg Salad Sandwich 
quick and easy 30 minute lunch recipe that you can meal prep in advance :) 

Macros:
C: 49 | F: 9 | P: 26
Calories: 382 for this recipe
Serves 1

Ingredients:
3 eggs, boiled, peeled and cut up, i use 1 yolk, 3 whites - do what you prefer, you can use more yolks :)
1 onion, finely chopped
3 tbsp greek yogurt, i use epigamia plain greek yogurt
1 tbsp mustard, dijon tastes best
1 tbsp wc sauce|barbeque sauce|tobasco
salt + pepper
handful of chopped coriander leaves
2 bread slices, i use whole wheat

Method
combine all the ingredients in a bowl and mix together to form your egg salad
top on your bread of choice and enjoy!

Tips: 
cutting carbs, use a lettuce wrap instead :) 
add more eggs for increased protein!
